description: 해양경찰청_국내 영향 태풍 현황 [fire, police and emergency services and typhoons, cyclones and storms] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 해양경찰청. 해양경찰청에서 발간한(21. 12) 2021 해양경찰 백서에서 제공한 5년간(2017~2021)의 월별 국내 영향 태풍 수를 정리한 데이터입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 해양경찰청. Its tags are 국내, 영향, 태풍, 재난안전. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-06-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
